▶️ Labubu is more expensive than memecoin

Pop Mart, the manufacturer of Labubu toys, reached a capitalization of $41 billion, which is more than Dogecoin ($39.6 billion). 

If Labubu were a crypto, it would rank 8th in the ranking, between USDC and DOGE. https://t.co/ldXasWBgvF

Grayscale has applied for a Dogecoin-ETF with the ticker GDOG

🤑 Grayscale has filed an application with the SEC to transform the Grayscale Dogecoin Trust into the first Dogecoin-based ETF in the United States.

✔️ After approval, the fund's securities will be traded on the NYSE https://t.co/rmc6s8n48v
